events.text: At 7:00 at Tri-Valley Freight’s Central Valley distribution center, two refrigerated trucks carrying produce arrive at once, but only one dock door has a working seal. One driver is close to the hours-of-service limit and asks to drop the trailer and leave.
events.title: Two trucks, one door

events.text: Darnell’s cycle count at Tri-Valley Freight shows 14 pallets of almonds missing from a lane the inventory system says is full. A customer pickup for those pallets is scheduled at noon, and nobody has touched the lane since the night shift.
events.title: The count is off

events.text: At Tri-Valley Freight, the dock thermometer reads 104°F, and the afternoon is forecast to get hotter. Two temps in their first week are skipping water breaks to keep up with the line rate set this morning.
events.title: Heat on the dock
